annotations.title: Ask to list a fence company in the directory

description: For a fence contractor who wants their company in the GroundQuote fence contractor directory (free). This does NOT create a listing. It emails a confirmation link to the contractor's own email; after they open it, GroundQuote checks the company website (it must open, be the company's own site and be a fence business) and confirms ownership (an email on the company domain, or a code to the business phone). The company is listed only when those checks pass; anything unclear is reviewed by a person. A company website is required. If the contractor has no website, do not call this: offer a GroundQuote hosted page instead (get_pricing_terms, then create_contractor_account and set_hosted_page). Use only when someone from the company asks and gives the details; never to add a company a homeowner mentioned, and never guess the email, phone or website.

business_phone.description: The business phone number, with area code

city.description: City the business is based in

company_name.description: Business name as it should appear in the directory

contact_name.description: Name of the person at the company

contractor_confirmed.description: Must be true: someone from this company asked for the listing and gave these details

contractor_email.description: The contractor's own email. The confirmation link is sent there; an address on the company's domain proves ownership fastest.

description.description: Short factual description in the contractor's words. No claims you cannot support.

materials.description: Fence materials they install. Ask; do not guess.

website.description: The company's own website (not a Facebook, Yelp or marketplace page). Required.
